short: Ahead on on-device few-shot command registration (M03); voiced enrollment and visual KWS activation are standard; superiority rests on an un-pretrained in-house baseline.
position: LipLearner [@su2023liplearner] changes command registration (M03), enrollment from a voiced utterance (M01) and activation by visual keyword spotting (M06). M03 is ahead: among 30 few-shot vocabulary studies only the target fits a linear classifier on a frozen encoder on the device (pattern match, Appendix), with a one-shot 25-command F1 of 0.8947 over 1,000 random draws (§5.3). M01 and M06 are standard: the voiced-to-silent loss (87.29% against 81.67%, §8.2.2) is the known overt-to-silent degradation, and visual-only keyword spotting predates the paper, which cites none of it [@stafylakis2018zeroshot; @momeni2020seeing]. The superiority claim rests on an in-house counterpart trained from scratch (0.9895 against 0.7147 F1, §5.4), and the contrastive stage is never ablated against its starting weights [@feng2020learn].
